Gate B (step 2.9): navigator's projection build now reads an incremental index (ADR-030) instead of scanning every reaction; measured 3-10x faster (design tier p99 was ~102ms, now ~11-33ms; mean ~78-79ms, now ~7-25ms). hub_explosion meets the 16ms budget on mean and most p99 runs; dense still exceeds p99 on most runs (mean close, 18-56ms) even with a realistic ~100-anchor benchmark state (withNavigatorAnchors, perf-kit.ts) — an honest, unresolved remaining gap, not an architectural failure of the fix. See PROGRESS.md step 2.9 for the full before/after table and candidate next steps (per-hub output ceiling, or filtering before gathering candidates).

Gate B (step 2.8/2.9): validateTouched on a 1,000-reaction hub misses the 16ms commit budget (24.34ms; rule execution over the touched record's full referrer fan-out). Not fixed; reviewer to decide fix-now vs. defer in 2.10.

Gate B: scopeOf is computed twice per commit (core/commands/store.ts calls it, then validateTouched calls it again internally) — confirmed real (2.0-2.1x its own cost) but small (~3-5% of a hub-heavy validateTouched); fixing it needs a Validator.validateTouched contract change, not attempted yet (2.10).

Gate B: the rejected-commit index rebuild costs ~163-180ms at the design tier; PERFORMANCE_ARCHITECTURE.md §2 has no budget row for this specific case (only for a successful commit) — reviewer to decide whether one should be added (2.10).

Gate B (step 2.9): recomputing benchmark verdicts on p99 instead of step 2.8's single-run means flipped several passes to fails (commit dispatch/undo-redo, reaction_explorer/precursor_explorer projection builds at the design tier) — not fixed, carried to 2.10's re-measurement and packet update.
npm run bench:compare (step 2.9, PERFORMANCE_ARCHITECTURE.md §9) exists now but is not wired into any CI workflow — it must be run manually at gates.

The command store (docs/PROGRESS.md step 2.1) still only maintains the part-1 coreIndexEngine, not the full indexEngine with navigatorRollup(); no live UI can read the navigator roll-up through the store yet.
